original_test_intent: Read the Redfish LogServices collection for one validated BMC Manager and inventory the log-service members without changing any log state.
original_method: Resolve the Manager from its collection, issue one trusted GET to its LogServices collection, validate collection identity, count and canonical member links, and export redacted evidence while preserving logs.
manual_activity: Provide the target endpoint, read-only credential handle, CA trust, firmware/API context and expected project member policy; no interactive test action is required.
safety_requirements: Never clear, delete or truncate logs
Never invoke ClearLog or member actions
Validate Manager membership and canonical URI
Redact sensitive identifiers while retaining evidence integrity
agent_execution_scope: Bind BMC, Manager and firmware identity
Capture HTTP metadata and restricted raw hash
Validate collection type, Members@odata.count and Members
Validate unique same-origin member URIs under the selected Manager
Compare required project members when defined

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The GET matches collection inspection, but the preceding Clear logs instruction is destructive and must not run; `-k`, hardcoded credentials, raw output and readability-only checks are also insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve the Manager and advertised LogServices link, use trusted TLS and a secret-provider credential for one bounded GET, validate collection/member identity and store redacted evidence without clearing logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Manager LogServices GET and 15/10 timing remain; no Manager instance or required member list is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Discover the canonical collection from the selected Manager, schema-check it and validate every member URI while preserving diagnostic history.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes destructive log clearing and adds identity, collection consistency, secure access, redaction and no-action controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Validates LogServices inventory only; it does not validate entries, clearing, retention or rollover behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A structurally valid collection can still omit project-required vendor services unless an expected-member policy is supplied.

project_override_considerations: Project firmware may expose vendor log services beyond standard names. Accept them only as canonical collection members; enforce a mandatory set only when the project supplies one.
expected_evidence: HTTP status/content type/timing and restricted raw hash
Proof no ClearLog, deletion, truncation or unrelated mutation occurred

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, path and GET align on collection retrieval. The unsafe clear-logs setup is a procedural defect, not an alternative test identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: All normal endpoint, credential, trust and schema inputs are identifiable runtime prerequisites for a read-only collection GET.

review_improvement: Preserves the diagnostic baseline and upgrades a readable dump into a Manager-bound, internally consistent LogServices inventory.
independent_technical_reasoning: Clearing logs before a log-service inventory is both unnecessary and harmful: it destroys the evidence needed to investigate request-side effects and can alter service metadata. A reliable collection test instead proves that the URI belongs to the selected Manager, that collection count and members agree, and that member links are unique, canonical and same-origin. This is fully automatable because it requires no physical stimulus or discretionary acceptance; project-specific mandatory members may be provided as data without changing the safe read-only execution model.
